outline:
積層製造(3D列印)加工原理、積層製造系統分類、加工參數與加工結果分析，製程設備研究，快速模具技術研究，積層製造與快速模具實習，專題研究與討論。

This course includes the principle of additive manufacturing process, classifications, process parameters, and the systems. The application of additive manufacturing will also introduce together with practice works. Two mini projects need to complete during this semester.
schedule:

)
8	MJT

10	PBF
11	DED
12	SHL (Alternative Fabrication Process/ Basic knowledge of cutting)
13	Exam
14	Applications (Industrial, Medical, Potential)
15-18 mini project, 15, 16 on-site, 17,18 optional

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
其他(Others)_Weeks 17 and 18 are dedicated to the 3D printing practice.
flexible_learning.content: Students will be divided into four teams. Each team is tasked with fully disassembling a 3D printer and correctly reassembling it to full operational status. During the final two weeks (week 17, 18), teams will independently schedule time to test their reassembled printer by successfully producing a sample 3D print.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students need to submit the final report and the printed object in the final week to the lab.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 20%. It is a part of the diligence and the report.
